answer: Novelty weight by compression distance: each passing answer is compared with the last 200 passes by NCD = (C(xy) - min(C(x),C(y))) / max(C(x),C(y)), zlib level 9. Reward is multiplied by the median NCD of its five nearest neighbours, floored at 0.1, so a paraphrase earns about a tenth and a copy farm pays ten times more per unit reward. Random padding inflates NCD, so tokens outside a 5000 word vocabulary are stripped first; clause shuffling is the cheapest bypass, so sorted sentence sets are compared too. Garden is the corpus, Crystal the sentence index, Spiral the scan order.
